title: First light of new laser on Adaptive Optics Facility at Paranal
caption: The first laser guide star unit launching its beam from the Very Large Telescope, Paranal Observatory
celestial: Landscape photograph; the source does not name the site

recognition.text: Published in the ESO image archive. No published rating.

story: A laser beam shoots into the night sky from Unit Telescope 4 of ESO's Very Large Telescope at Paranal. The picture marks first light for the first of four laser guide star units, achieved by the team behind the 4 Laser Guide Star Facility on the night of Wednesday 29 April 2015.

A laser guide star is an artificial point of light created high in the atmosphere. Telescopes can measure how the atmosphere distorts that point and correct for the blurring. This first unit was a key step toward building the full Adaptive Optics Facility, which is designed to sharpen the telescope's view in this way.
The photograph records that milestone at Unit Telescope 4, with the remaining laser units still to follow. Adaptive optics systems cancel the blurring with a mirror that constantly changes shape.
